description: This file defines code-behind for the EditTheory.aspx page in an online examination system, handling navigation, session management, and dynamic course list population based on semester selection.

classes.name: EditTheory
classes.description: Code-behind class for the EditTheory.aspx page, managing user interactions and dynamic content updates on the page.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load events; currently empty, can be used for initial setup.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Admin panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Admin Queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Admin Leaderboard page.

methods.name: searchB_Click
methods.description: Sets session value for selected course.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by transferring to the login page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on selected semester.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles change in semester selection and updates course list accordingly.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Event handler for changes in course selection (currently empty).
